svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.55k stars in total, about 1.92k a year earlier. jactionlint 351, mr boxington 785, aube 2076, fnox 2416, hk 1352, pitchfork 720, usage 1080, +6 more 771.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
